description: This file contains extension methods for the BufferWriter class, providing efficient, inlined methods for writing ReadOnlySequence<byte> and ReadOnlySpan<byte> data to a buffer writer, with a specialized multi-segment write method.

classes.name: BufferWriterExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IBufferWriter<byte> to facilitate writing sequences and spans of bytes efficiently.

methods.name: Write<TBufferWriter>(this ref TBufferWriter writer, ReadOnlySequence<byte> input)
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySequence<byte> to the buffer writer by iterating over its segments.

methods.name: Write<TBufferWriter>(ref this TBufferWriter writer, ReadOnlySpan<byte> value)
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to the buffer writer, attempting a fast path for contiguous data and falling back to multi-segment writing if necessary.

methods.name: WriteMultiSegment<TBufferWriter>(ref TBufferWriter writer, in ReadOnlySpan<byte> source, Span<byte> destination)
methods.description: Handles writing a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to the buffer when data spans multiple segments by copying in chunks.
